entry.title: Doom 2016 Composer Mick Gordon Is Performing the Game's Soundtrack at a Music Festival for the Very First Time
entry.summary: Mick Gordon, the composer of Doom 2016’s award-winning soundtrack, is taking the game’s music on tour for the first time ever — and he’s bringing the Doom Machine with him.

entry.title: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick Won't Rule Out GTA 6 on Disc at Some Point, Insists Decision Had Nothing to Do With Concern Over Leaks
entry.summary: One of the big questions following the shock decision not to release GTA 6 on-disc at launch is whether Rockstar will ever release a disc version of the game. In a new interview with IGN, Strauss Zelnick, boss of Rockstar parent company Take-Two, refused to rule it out.

entry.title: 'Pricing Has Not Kept Pace With Inflation' — Take-Two Boss Insists Rockstar Got GTA 6 Standard and Ultimate Edition Price Points Right
entry.summary: The standard edition of GTA 6 costs $80, which represents a $10 increase on the established price of a triple-A console game. That hike raised more than a few eyebrows when Rockstar launched GTA 6 preorders in June. So, what’s the thinking behind it? We asked Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick in a new interview with IGN.

entry.title: Take-Two Boss Defends No Disc Version of GTA 6, Equates Physical Releases to Vinyl Records
entry.summary: Strauss Zelnick, boss of Rockstar parent company Take-Two, has defended the company’s decision not to release GTA 6 on a physical disc, insisting when it comes to big games, discs “don’t really make sense for the consumer.”
